# vastdata_de_metric_names (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Discover available metrics and their metadata (`name`, `type`, `unit`, `scope`, `description`).
# Useful before querying `vastdata_de_metrics`, which requires all metrics in a single query
# to have the same `type` (e.g., all `Counter` or all `Histogram`).
data "vastdata_de_metric_names" "example" {
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
  pipeline    = "my-pipeline"
}

output "metric_names" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_metric_names.example.items
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `function` (String) Filter metrics by function name
- `metric_type` (String) Filter metrics by type (Counter, Histogram, Gauge, UpDownCounter)
- `pipeline` (String) Filter metrics by pipeline name
- `search` (String) Filter metric names containing this string (case-insensitive substring match)
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes Set) List of discovered metrics with their metadata (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the metric
- `name` (String) Name of the metric
- `scope` (String) OpenTelemetry scope name (e.g., "vast-runtime", "user")
- `type` (String) Type of metric (Counter, Histogram, Gauge, UpDownCounter)
- `unit` (String) Unit of the metric (ms, bytes, percent, etc.)
